description: §14.8.9 S443 round 6 (L3) — writing a protected column into a global store (`process.env`, `globalThis`, …) is an egress, and a later read of the store (here in another server function) carries the column: E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: §14.8.9 (S441 amendment): provenance is preserved through "writes into a container", and a value reaching an egress outside a row is E-PROTECT-006. Global names read as clean and their writes landed nowhere, so `stash` + `peek` served the hash across two requests over HTTP (measured, S443 round 6). A global store is now one compile-wide cell: a write of a value outside a row into it is an egress, and every read of it carries what was written.
